reading: The sketch lays out a full calendar app page: a top header bar with title and nav links/buttons, a left sidebar holding an open date-range mini-calendar picker plus a calendars list, a large main week-view grid with day headers, hour labels and colored event blocks, and a small red current-time indicator line inside the grid.
